properties.source: Derived: the convex hull of this port's terminals and way 55501385 from OpenStreetMap, grown by 300 m
properties.note: OpenStreetMap maps no port limits for Sevilla. These are the hull of the terminals below and the Dársena del Batán, grown by 300 m, which takes in the canal along the quays. The city centre and Triana are outside, and so is the 80 km of river to the sea. The residential streets of Los Remedios and Tablada are outside, but the limits take in the southern half of the Real de la Feria fairground, north of the Exolum depot.

properties.name: Terminal de contenedores
properties.note: The container terminal on the Muelle del Centenario, between the Dársena del Batán and the canal. The port authority's 30-year concession to Terminal Marítima del Guadalquivir (Boluda and OPDR) covers about 18 ha with 350 m of berth and the ro-ro ramp; this area is 18 ha. OpenStreetMap names it Terminal de contenedores and gives Puerto de Sevilla as operator.

properties.name: Berths
properties.note: The petroleum products depot on the Muelle del Batán, on the right bank of the canal, where the port authority let Exolum occupy land for three of its tanks in 2024, and Exolum applied for a concession over it in 2025 (BOE). Mapped as landuse=industrial.
